## Exploratory Server: expl server

expl server calls the same operations as the Exploratory Server MCP. Run `expl server login` once on
each machine (or set EXPL_SERVER_TOKEN from `expl server token create` for CI).

Use expl server when you have a shell and files; use the Remote MCP when you only have a chat client.
Save large results to a file with --output (for example `expl server dataset query ... --output out.csv`)
and read only the part you need, instead of printing them into the conversation.
Published content: expl server. Local projects: the Desktop expl.

List commands: `expl server tools list --json`. Exit code 3 means the server is unreachable;
exit code 4 means not logged in or the token was rejected.
